text:
Maya (AE): Quick sync: Bankly wants a 2-week pilot with EU-only data plane, BYOK, and a signed subprocessor snapshot for the pilot window. Can we scope this?
Diego (SE): Control-plane signaling ok if metadata-only per their legal. Confirm: they require logs/traces to remain in EU as well?
Maya (AE): Yes, logs and traces must be EU-resident for pilot.
Zoe (Ops): Ok, we can pin tenant to eu-west-1 and enable eu-only observability sinks for the tenant. BYOK via KMS connector in eu-west is supported. BYO-HSM not doable for a short pilot.
Harper (Security): I'll prepare the attestation and SCQ fills. Need ops to produce subprocessor snapshot (storage, infra, monitoring) scoped to pilot dates. Also will add wording: no cross-border failover without 24h written notice.
Ola (Pricing): Note that single-region pinning and BYOK carry an infra uplift — reserved capacity in EU + support. Rough preliminary quote for 2 weeks: €6k-€10k. I'll formalize.
Diego (SE): Implementation plan suggestion:
- tenant: bankly-poc-2026
- residency: pin to eu-west-1 (hot-standby eu-central within EU)
- models: prefer EU-hosted quant variants; fallback to same-family within EU
- kms: customer-key-arn -> map via connector
- observability: eu-only export for duration
- routing: strict_pin=true, fallback=queue+notify
Zoe (Ops): If strict_pin=true autoscaling limited to EU capacity. If saturated we'll queue or 429. We can implement an approved manual failover process but need signed approval from customer each time.
Maya (AE): Bankly accepts queuing for POC but wants an escalation path if p50 latency jumps >2s.
Harper (Security): Ops please confirm where traces currently export from runtime (service name/endpoint) so I can validate in attestation. Also redact PII from traces.
Zoe (Ops): Current tracing exports to obs.redwood.global by default. For this tenant we'll flip to obs-eu.redwood (EU-only) with a config toggle. Will provide a daily snapshot of subprocessors for the pilot dates.
cicd-bot: residency-pin apply requested for tenant bankly-poc-2026 -> job#9187 queued
Ola (Pricing): I'll attach the internal quote link once ready.
Diego (SE): I'll prepare a short eval checklist and a sample prompt set to compare model quality/latency across EU vs global variants.
Maya (AE): Action items: Diego draft tech packet + eval set. Zoe produce subprocessor snapshot + runbook for manual failover. Harper finalize attestation & SCQ. Ola send quote. We'll aim to send the package tomorrow morning.
Maya (AE): Thanks all :thumbsup:
